name: Ring of the Competent Bowman
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a marksman’s ring and functions as such. However, checks to confirm critical hits with a missile weapon are made with a -5 penalty.

This ring may be removed freely.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items marksman’s ring

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
